# kplotly.r

Site: <https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/> (development version:
[/dev](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/))

An interactive plot with several series, a shared legend and a range
slider quickly costs a dozen lines of `plot_ly()` / `add_trace()` /
[`layout()`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/layout.html) calls and
long-format bookkeeping. **kplotly.r** draws a complete interactive plot
in one short call, and plots stay composable through the `kplotly` S3
class. It is the plotly.js counterpart of
[kggplot](https://github.com/kbosirany/kggplot), with the same
arguments: changing `kggplot(` into `kplotly(` turns a static plot into
an interactive one.

plotly.js is embedded (the “cartesian” bundle): kplotly.r only depends
on htmlwidgets, not on the plotly R package and its dependencies.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("kbosirany/kplotly.r")
```

## Example

``` r

library(kplotly.r)

# A time series: several columns, a range slider and a unified hover
weather <- data.frame(date = as.Date("2024-01-01") + 0:364)
weather$rain <- rgamma(365, 0.4, 0.1)
weather$temp <- 12 + 8 * sin(1:365 / 58 - 1.5)
kplotly(weather, "date", c("rain", "temp"), title = "Weather")

# kplot / TSstudio style calls
kplotly(weather, vars = list(x = "date", y = "all"), type = "point")

# Superpose layers: shared colours, one legend entry per level
obs <- data.frame(t = 1:20, v = (1:20)^1.2 + rnorm(20))
sim <- data.frame(t = 1:20, v = (1:20)^1.2)
kplotly(obs, "t", "v", color = "Observed", type = "point", theme = "inrae") +
  kplotly(sim, "t", "v", color = "Simulated", type = "line")

# Any plotly.js layout attribute, and the htmlwidget for Shiny
p <- kplotly(iris, "Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", color = "Species") |>
  kply_layout(hovermode = "x")
as_htmlwidget(p)
```

See
[`vignette("kplotly")`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/articles/kplotly.md)
(“Get started”) for the full tour.

Branch, version and release conventions are those of
[kpkg.r](https://github.com/kbosirany/kpkg.r):
`vignette("workflow", package = "kpkg.r")`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as_htmlwidget()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/as_htmlwidget.md)
  : Convert to an htmlwidget
- [`as_kdata()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/as_kdata.md)
  : Convert an input object to a data frame for kplotly
- [`kplotly()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kplotly.md)
  : Draw a complete interactive plot in one call
- [`kply_add()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_modify.md)
  [`kply_labs()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_modify.md)
  [`kply_theme()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_modify.md)
  [`kply_palette()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_modify.md)
  [`kply_legend()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_modify.md)
  [`kply_slider()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_modify.md)
  [`kply_layout()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_modify.md)
  [`kply_config()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_modify.md)
  : Modify a kplotly
- [`kply_register_theme()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_register_theme.md)
  [`kply_register_palette()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_register_theme.md)
  [`kply_themes()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_register_theme.md)
  [`kply_palettes()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_register_theme.md)
  : Themes and palettes
- [`kply_register_type()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_register_type.md)
  [`kply_types()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_register_type.md)
  : Plot types
- [`kply_save()`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/kply_save.md)
  : Save a kplotly to an HTML file
- [`` `+`( ``*`<kplotly>`*`)`](https://kbosirany.github.io/kplotly.r/dev/reference/plus-.kplotly.md)
  : Add layers or widget steps to a kplotly
